# Test RIGHT and LEFT: does the handle (right 2x2 box) move horizontally along the bar?
def handle(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation['nodes']; out=[]
    for nd in seg:
        bnd=nd['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bnd); r1=max(p[0] for p in bnd)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bnd); c1=max(p[1] for p in bnd)
        if 17<=r0<=22 and c0>=36:
            out.append((nd['color'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return sorted(out)
print("now:",handle(current_frame))
r=action(['RIGHT'])
print("after RIGHT:",handle(current_frame))
r=action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:",handle(current_frame))
r=action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN:",handle(current_frame))
# also check grid W/N and bar right edge
def gridstate(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation['nodes']; w=n=0
    for nd in seg:
        bnd=nd['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bnd); c0=min(p[1] for p in bnd)
        if 48<=r0<=62 and 23<=c0<=37:
            if nd['color']=='W': w+=nd['pixels']
            if nd['color']=='N': n+=nd['pixels']
    return w,n
print("grid W,N:",gridstate(current_frame))

</function>
